questions.content:
A ball is thrown from a point with a speed ν<sub>0</sub> at an angle of projection θ. From the same point
and at the same instant person starts running with a constant speed <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.781ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2.47ex" height="2.523ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -770.3 1091.6 1115.3" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="mfrac"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" transform="translate(220,457.1) scale(0.707)" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D463" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D463"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(518,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="30" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-30"></use></g></g></g></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(369,-345) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="32" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-32"></use></g><rect width="851.6" height="60" x="120" y="220"></rect></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> to catch the ball.
Will the person be able to catch the ball? If yes, what should be the angle of projection θ?

questions.explanation:
Yes, the person can catch the ball when horizontal velocity is equal to the horizontal component of ball's velocity, the motion of ball will be only in vertical direction with respect to person for that,
